import json, sys
import mod.client.extraClientApi as api
from modern_projection.pyreact import navigator
saved = sys._shield_banner_geometry_r20
owner = api.GetSystem('ModernProjection', 'ModernProjectionClientSystem')
s = owner.session
removed = []
for row in saved['controls']:
    row['control'].SetVisible(False)
    returned = saved['node'].RemoveChildControl(row['control'])
    assert returned
    removed.append(returned)
s.tiles.cancel()
s.editor = saved['editor']
for key, value in saved['fields'].items():
    setattr(s, key, value)
s.model_revision = None
s.camera_reset_revision += 1
s.refresh_preview()
s.emit()
if not saved['workspace'] and navigator.contains('modern_projection_workspace'):
    navigator.pop()
assert s.editor is saved['editor']
assert navigator.contains('modern_projection_workspace') == saved['workspace']
_result = json.dumps({'controls_removed': removed, 'editor_restored': True,
                      'workspace_restored': True, 'step': saved['step'],
                      'last_label': saved.get('last_label')})
del sys._shield_banner_geometry_r20
